name: telnyx-developer-kit
description: Build and debug Telnyx integrations with four focused skills and an OAuth-authenticated hosted MCP connector exposing five reviewed tools for a bounded Call Control and recording catalog and account reads.

interface.longDescription: Plan, build, review, and debug communications applications with Telnyx. Four bundled skills cover product selection, architecture, production guardrails, and troubleshooting. The OAuth-authenticated hosted MCP connector exposes exactly five focused tools: discovery and schema inspection for three reviewed endpoints, plus account-scoped call status, call events, and recording search. Other products require separate API documentation and integrations.
capabilities: Inspect reviewed Telnyx API and account data through OAuth
